name: Eran
desc:
Eran was a minor character in the book God in the Machine.

She's a close friend of [Ryrda](entity:ryrda) and a girlfriend of Fran. She agreed to help [Ryrda](entity:ryrda) with getting the Nightblood for him, even though she was sick. Ryrda was way too desperate to tell her she might die of ether vacancy, which eventually led to her death.

After Fran discovered Eran's lifeless body she was filled with rage, killing [Ryrda](entity:ryrda) in revenge for Eran.
additional_info: -   Eran was never stated to be Fran's girlfriend, but the way Fran spoke about her hints at that.
